name: Geometric Aug + Residual Refinement
tagline: Concatenates raw obs with explicit relative-pose features (rel_pos, distance, log-distance, unit direction, quat-position outer-product, gripper*distance) plus a zero-init residual MLP refinement.
formula:
$$\Delta = o[:3] - p,\ d = \Vert\Delta\Vert,\ \hat{u} = \Delta/d$$
$$z_{\text{geo}} = [\Delta, d, \log d, \hat{u}, W_{12\to 8}\tanh(q\otimes\Delta), g\odot d]$$
$$x = [o_{\text{raw}}, z_{\text{geo}}],\ y = x + \mathrm{MLP}_{\text{0-init}}(\mathrm{LN}(x))$$

key_hyperparams.name: quat-rel compress
key_hyperparams.role: compresses quaternion x rel_pos outer product

init_recovers: Default raw-concat encoder at init (refinement is zero)
diff_from_baseline: Beyond default concat baseline: appends 18 hand-crafted relative-geometry features (relative position, distance, log distance, unit direction, quaternion-position outer-product compressed via 12->8 linear+tanh, gripper*distance), then a zero-init residual MLP refinement.

name: Modality-Group Soft Gating
tagline: Encodes pose (eef_pos+quat), gripper, and object as 3 group features, computes softmax gate over the three groups from a context MLP, fuses weighted-sum + per-group features through an output MLP.
formula:
$$f_{\text{pose}} = \mathrm{MLP}_p([p, q]),\ f_{\text{grip}} = \mathrm{MLP}_g(g),\ f_{\text{obj}} = \mathrm{MLP}_o(o)$$
$$\alpha = \mathrm{softmax}\!\bigl(\mathrm{MLP}_{\text{gate}}([p, q, g, o])\bigr) \in \mathbb{R}^{3}$$
$$z_{\text{sum}} = \alpha_1 f_{\text{pose}} + \alpha_2 f_{\text{grip}} + \alpha_3 f_{\text{obj}}$$
$$y = \mathrm{MLP}_{\text{out}}\!\bigl([z_{\text{sum}}, f_{\text{pose}}, f_{\text{grip}}, f_{\text{obj}}]\bigr)$$
diff_from_baseline: Compared to gated_fusion baseline: groups eef_pos+quat into one 'pose' modality (3 groups, not 4), uses a softmax-over-groups gate driven by a context MLP on all raw obs (rather than per-modality sigmoid on its own input), and concatenates both the gated-sum AND each group feature into an output MLP.

name: ViT Fusion Token over Modalities
tagline: Per-modality linear projection plus learned modality embeddings, prepended with a [FUSION] CLS token and run through a 2-layer pre-norm Transformer; CLS output concatenated with raw features.
formula:
$$t_k = W_k\,o_k + e_k,\ k\in\mathcal{K},\quad t_0 = \text{[FUSION]}$$
$$X = [t_0, t_1, \dots, t_M],\ Z = \mathrm{TransformerEnc}_{2,4}(X)$$
$$y = [\mathrm{LN}(Z_0),\, o_{\text{raw}}]$$
diff_from_baseline: Generalizes attention_fusion baseline: adds a learnable [FUSION] CLS token and per-modality learnable embeddings, runs a 2-layer pre-norm Transformer encoder (rather than a single MHA), then concatenates the LN-ed CLS feature with the raw concat skip connection.

name: Bilinear Robot-Object + Rel Geometry
tagline: Encodes robot, object, and 4-D relative-pose features, then forms a sigmoid-gated multiplicative robot*object interaction in latent space; concatenates fused + raw features.
formula:
$$z_r = \mathrm{BlockMLP}(o_{\text{robot}}),\ z_o = \mathrm{BlockMLP}(o_{\text{object}})$$
$$r = [p - o[:3],\ \Vert p-o[:3]\Vert],\ z_{\text{rel}} = \mathrm{MLP}_{\text{rel}}(r)$$
$$g = \sigma(W_g z_{\text{rel}}),\ I = g \odot W_r z_r \odot W_o z_o$$
$$y = \bigl[\mathrm{Fuse}([z_r + I,\, z_o + g\odot I,\, z_{\text{rel}},\, I]),\ o_{\text{robot}},\ o_{\text{object}}\bigr]$$
diff_from_baseline: Distinct from attention_fusion / gated_fusion baselines: builds an explicit relative-geometry token, a sigmoid-gated bilinear robot*object multiplicative interaction in a 32-D latent, and combines with both raw modalities; no attention used.

name: Relative-Product Fusion (RPF)
tagline: Three per-modality MLPs (pose, grip, obj), two product interactions (pose*obj, grip*obj), an explicit rel-pose feature, all fused with raw concat through a Linear+ReLU+LN+Linear stack.
formula:
$$f_p = \mathrm{MLP}([p, q]),\ f_g = \mathrm{MLP}(g),\ f_o = \mathrm{MLP}(o)$$
$$h_{po} = \mathrm{MLP}(f_p \odot f_o),\ h_{go} = \mathrm{MLP}(f_g \odot f_o)$$
$$z_{\text{rel}} = \mathrm{MLP}([p - o[:3],\ q\odot o[3:7]])$$
$$y = \mathrm{Fuse}\bigl([o_{\text{raw}},\ h_{po},\ h_{go},\ z_{\text{rel}}]\bigr)$$
diff_from_baseline: Goes beyond gated_fusion / attention_fusion baselines by adding two latent elementwise product interactions (pose*obj, grip*obj) and an explicit relative-pose featurizer (eef-pos minus object position, eef-quat element-wise object-quat), all combined with a raw-concat residual through a 4*embed_dim fusion MLP.
